entries.en:
The bristles are extremely soft so you can gently clean teeth and gums with ultimate care.

The ultra thin, featherlight bristle hairs helps to dispurge the toothpaste and makes sure the Awake of Asleep reach the smallest, darkest places between teeth and your gumline. Making sure your teeth and gums are nurished by each mineral in our toothpaste.

Head is not too big or too small. Perfectly fits 2 to 4 applications with Awake/Asleep toothpaste.

Lasting longer when combined with KARMICARE Evening Toothbrush.

Kickstart your day the KARMICARE way.
